channel.title: Maze incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Maze's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Build mode and Live study links for unmoderated studies with Figma prototypes fail to load [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the incident, and unmoderated studies with Figma prototypes should now work normally. Apologies for the trouble caused.

item.title: Users can’t duplicate an existing unmoderated study or create a new unmoderated study from a template [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the issue, and you should now be able to duplicate unmoderated studies and create new studies from a template. Sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your patience.

item.title: Calendar availability not showing when creating recruitment links [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Teammates' calendar connection status displays correctly again in the recruitment link creation flow, and live availability is being applied as expected.

item.title: Video streams unresponsive in Observer Rooms [resolved]
item.description: Video streaming has been restored in moderated observer rooms.

item.title: AI Moderated studies aren't functioning correctly [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting AI Moderated studies has now been fully resolved. AI Moderated interactions and study links are functioning normally again, including studies with image stimuli.
We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience and understanding while we worked to resolve the issue.

item.title: Prototype test 'goal-based' tasks are not consistently auto-completing [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Goal-based prototype tests will now auto-complete consistently when participants reach the defined goal screen. Thank you for your patience while we worked towards a fix.

item.title: AI Moderated conversations [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting AI Moderated conversations has been resolved.
Our Engineering team identified the root cause and implemented a fix. AI Moderated conversations should now be starting normally.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: Delays in transcript generation on unmoderated studies [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Thank you for your patience while we worked towards a fix.

item.title: Maze app experiencing longer load times [resolved]
item.description: This incident is now resolved, and all services are working as expected 🎉

item.title: Clips and transcripts aren't loading in results [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Clips and transcripts should now be loading as expected in results.

item.title: Some Figma prototypes fail to load in unmoderated studies [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved, and prototypes should load as expected. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience while we investigated the issue.

item.title: Observers are unable to join moderated studies [resolved]
item.description: The issue is now resolved. Observers should be able to join and access moderated interview studies as expected.

item.title: Moderated and AI Moderated study types cannot be accessed or created [resolved]
item.description: We've now implemented a fix. Moderated and AI Moderated studies are now accessible and can be created as expected.

item.title: Recruiting unavailable for Respondent panel orders [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting recruiting for Respondent panel orders has been fully resolved. Recruiting services are now operating as expected. We will continue to monitor the system to ensure stability.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: In-app prompt will not show on our customers website [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved. We have restored full functionality and are continuing to monitor the system. We appreciate your patience while we worked on this.

item.title: Clips are failing to load [resolved]
item.description:
The issue where Clips failed to load and displayed the error message “Unable to load video” has been resolved by our Engineering Team.
We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding while we addressed this matter.

item.title: Clip recordings are not displaying in results [resolved]
item.description: The backlog of Clips recordings have been processed and the system is operating normally

item.title: Users can't log into their Maze accounts via Google Auth [resolved]
item.description: Issue has now been resolved. You should now be able to login with Google. Thank you for your patience

item.title: Issues placing participant panel orders [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Panel orders can be submitted and created as expected.

item.title: The 'Get started' button loads indefinitely on Android browsers when the unmoderated study contains a prototype block [resolved]
item.description: This issue is now resolved. Thank you for your patience while we worked towards a fix.

item.title: Search failing due to provider outage [resolved]
item.description: Search in Maze should now be operational again. Thanks for your patience while we worked towards a fix.

item.title: An error stating "Failed to load" appears when attempting to view the Legal block [resolved]
item.description: The CDN configuration has been fixed and the system is fully operational

item.title: PDFs and images not loading for testers [resolved]
item.description: The CDN configuration has been fixed and the system is fully operational

item.title: The Search option is currently not working as expected [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been identified and resolved. We are not seeing any errors with search queries but will continue to monitor.

item.title: CSV exports not being delivered [resolved]
item.description: We experienced an issue where CSV exports from studies were not being delivered to inboxes. We've identified the root cause and implemented a fix. Previously requested exports can be requested again in order to receive them. Our apologies for any disruption this may have caused.
